target_customer: Beauty shoppers and beauty sellers using a mobile live stream shopping app
problem: Shoppers want to see beauty products demonstrated live before buying, and small sellers lack a place to stream sales.
business_model: Live commerce marketplace app; an unverified profile says revenue came mainly from delivery fees

founders.name: Kirill Avery
previous_startups: European version of HQ Trivia (about 15 million organic downloads per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was the youngest employee at VK and later built alien.org.

founders.name: Yurii Kyparus (Yatsenko)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Facebook work on Infra and Oculus and Google work on Play, Assistant, Maps and Cloud.

competitors.name: NTWRK
competitors.what: Live shopping app aimed at Gen Z
competitors.traction_then: 2.2 million users, mostly Gen Z, per Modern Retail

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile live video with commerce, payments and delivery logistics is standard engineering with hard parts around streaming and fulfilment, handled by two engineers with large platform backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Seller and viewer liquidity could create a network effect, but larger apps and later TikTok Shop could reach the same users.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Modern Retail in December 2021 said live shopping platforms were preparing for battle with big tech in 2022; no source ties this to Lalabox.

market_need_then: Live shopping was growing in the US in 2021 as shown by Modern Retail coverage of NTWRK and Whatnot, and beauty brands ran live classes. No Lalabox specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Site is lalabox.io; contact email on the site uses a matt.fun domain.
branding.community_and_virality: Has TikTok and Instagram accounts named lalaboxio; no press found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence. Search results confuse it with Lolabox, an Indonesian beauty box that shut down.

outcome_analysis: Lalabox was a four person Winter 2021 live beauty shopping app founded by two engineers from VK, Facebook and Google. YC marks it Inactive, but the landing page and App Store link still load, and no shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned. Only a roughly 130 thousand dollar seed from one database is known, which suggests it never raised a priced round in a market where larger live commerce players raised tens of millions.
notes: The seed rests on a single database (CB Insights, dated 1 January 2021, possibly a placeholder). Extruct adds Daniel Schryer as an investor and says Lalabox is a rebrand of Matt.fun and that revenue comes from delivery fees; these are unverified. CB Insights gives founded 2020 and Los Angeles, YC gives 2021 and San Francisco. Competitor source is dated July 2021, about four months after the W21 Demo Day. The site is live, so Inactive status may reflect a pivot or low activity.
